ORDER TO SHOW CAUSE FOR CHANGE OF NAME
Off Calendar Jun-08-2004 Granted Per Written Order
MINI MINUTES: This cause came on regularly as scheduled for OSC hearing for Change of Name of a three minors.
Commissioner Sue Kaplan, Clerk: S. Ravinantapricha, CSR: Gena Eales.
Petitioners: Maria Celia rivera and Victor Rivera are present in pro per for the three minors: Victor Alexander Rivera Castro, Jennifer Gloriannie Rivera Castro and Cecilia Michelle Rivera Castro, were sworn and examined.
It appears to the satisfaction of the Court that all the allegations in the petitions are true, correct, and sufficient and that the petitions should be granted.
The Court grants the petition for change of the MINOR'S name to: Victor Alexander Rivera, Jennifer Gloriannie Rivera and Cecilia Michelle Rivera.
Decree signed in open court.
